title: Doe-1: Closed-Loop Autonomous Driving with Large World Model

output_modality.value: front-camera image tokens (single view) for predicted observations, plus scene-description text and ego action tokens

control_signal.value: ego action as BEV displacement trajectory or high-level command (turn left, go straight, overtake), plus text question prompts for perception

control_mechanism.value: position-aware tokenizer turns actions into discrete tokens, interleaved with image and text tokens in one sequence; next-token prediction in a unified multimodal autoregressive transformer

base_model.value: Chameleon-style multimodal autoregressive transformer with image VQ tokenizer; initialized from pretrained Lumina-mGPT 7B and fine-tuned on BDD100k for 5 epochs

datasets.value: nuScenes (700 train, 150 val scenes), OmniDrive-nuScenes for question answering, BDD100k for image fine-tuning

metrics.value: FID for action-conditioned video; METEOR, CIDEr, ROUGE, counterfactual AP and AR for QA; L2 error and collision rate for planning

controllability_evidence.value: Table 2 reports FID 15.9 for action-conditioned generation (Vista 6.9, Drive-WM 15.8); Fig. 8 shows qualitative turn left, go straight, overtake. No action-following metric in packet.

closed_loop.value: Claims closed loop by alternating observation, description, action autoregressively with next-frame planning; reported evaluation is L2 and collision on nuScenes. Rollout length not stated in packet.

stated_limitations.value: Only front-view images are used because multi-view input is inefficient; surround-view information is called critical for safe driving.

notes: Unified perception, prediction and planning model; image generation is one task. Planning metrics paragraph mentions GaussianAD, probably a copy artifact. Unclear whether closed-loop was tested interactively.
